label: Securities account
Ange aktiens identitet utan inledande el: Enter the share identity without leading or trailing spaces.
Ange ett giltigt antal aktier; ett inneh: Enter a valid number of shares; a holding with value must contain more than zero shares.
Ange en positiv nominell aktiekurs vid d: Enter a positive nominal share price at the future opening.
En framtida VP-depå ska ha noll aktier v: An account opening in the future must have zero shares at the calculation date.
Ett tomt aktieinnehav kan inte ha omkost: An empty share holding cannot have a cost basis.
Ange aktieslag även för ägarens övriga V: Identify the shares in all of this owner’s securities accounts before calculating pooled cost basis.
Samma aktie för samma ägare måste ha sam: The same owner’s shares of the same class must have the same price and return assumptions in every account.
Ange giltiga inställningar för svensk sk: Enter valid settings for Swedish tax after emigration.
Kontots förval är vanliga aktier förvärv: The default is ordinary shares acquired before the move. Change it if that is not correct.
Aktier som omfattas av tioårsregeln (för: Shares covered by the ten-year rule (default)
Bekräftad avtalsbegränsning undantar vär: Confirmed treaty restriction exempts securities gains from Swedish tax
Svensk depå med aktier och fonder: vinst: Swedish securities account with shares and funds: gains and losses are estimated from market value and average cost basis. Purchases increase cost basis; partial sales reduce it proportionally.
The default national rate is 30%. Tax treaties can reduce Swedish dividend tax.
Svensk aktiedepå: vanliga aktier förvärv: Swedish securities account: ordinary shares acquired before departure are assumed to fall under the ten-year rule. Confirmed treaty restrictions may change Swedish tax.
